artworks.title: German Joust of Peace
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a jousting scene between two armored figures on horseback. The image includes two horses, each carrying an armored rider in detailed plate armor. The left horse has a red and gold drapery while the right horse has a green drapery. The armor and horse drapery are intricately detailed with contrasting colors and designs. One figure is shown being unhorsed, adding motion to the scene.

artworks.title: German Joust of Peace
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an armored joust between two mounted knights. The artwork depicts two knights on horseback engaged in a jousting match. Both knights are clad in full armor with distinctive helmets and plume designs. The horse on the left has a brown caparison, while the one on the right is adorned in a green and white patterned cloth. Both horses are in action, capturing the movement and energy of the duel. Broken lances are shown, indicating a clash. Additionally, there is a small inscription and a piece of paper with handwriting attached at the bottom.

artworks.title: German Joust of Peace
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two armored horses engaged in a jousting scene. It shows two horses, one draped in red, white, and blue cloth, and the other in green. The horse on the left appears to be falling or kneeling, with an armored figure entangled with it. Both horses are heavily armored, and the scene is depicted with intricate detail, showcasing the colorful clothing and armor styles. The drawing conveys a sense of action and movement, capturing a tense moment during the jousting event.

artworks.title: Joust of Peace in Leg Armor
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over black chalk and leadpoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of two armored knights jousting on horseback. The scene captures the moment of a medieval jousting tournament where two knights, fully clad in armor, are mounted on decorated horses, charging towards each other. One knight appears to have been struck and is falling off his horse, while the other knight remains upright. The horses are adorned in caparisons with green and gold colors, and the knights hold lances. The detailing and the historical theme suggest the artwork may be in the style of medieval manuscript illustrations. The painting depicts the action and pageantry typical of such events.

artworks.title: German Joust of Peace
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a jousting scene. It shows two armored knights on horses engaged in a joust, each holding a lance. The knight on the left has a brown barding on his horse and elaborate feather plumes on his helmet. The knight on the right has blue and red trappings on his horse and a helm with a cruciform motif. Both knights have intricate patterns on their armor. The painting is formal and detailed, reminiscent of late-Renaissance or early Baroque art focusing on chivalric events.

artworks.title: Joust of Peace in Leg Armor

artworks.description: A drawing of a jousting scene featuring armored knights on horseback. The image shows two knights colliding, their lances shattered and fragments flying. The horses are covered with decorative cloth, one solid brown and the other striped. The drawing portrays movement and tension through effective use of lines and shading.

artworks.title: German Joust of Peace

artworks.title: Mock Joust of War with Fixed Shields

The winning knight on the right is steady on his horse, adorned with red, white, and green-striped barding and a plume on his helmet. The artwork showcases the moment of impact during a joust, capturing action and colorful pageantry associated with historical tournaments. The painting is detailed in capturing the elegance and tension of the medieval sport, reminiscent of Hans Burgkmair's style.
